facts.statement: The Dares performed a live concert on the Snowhill stage in Free Realms, streamed in real time from E3, on June 2 at 4pm Pacific.
facts.quote: experience the music of Free Realms in a concert on the Snowhill stage June 2nd at 4pm Pacific

article_summaries.title: Rock Out with The Dares
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com 'What is New?' news post announcing an in-game concert by The Dares on the Snowhill stage, performed live at E3 and viewable in-game. The Dares were to perform the Free Realms theme song 'It's Your World'. The post date is not exact; the page only says it was posted 3 days, 2 hours before capture (2009-06-02).
